A lead also needs a non-empty domain, external_key, or non-empty proposed_data object as identifying information. Arbitrary other keys are stored but do not automatically map to CRM columns; existing-company fields are not overwritten. Use evidence/notes for other facts and crm_propose_update after acceptance for allowed field changes.

agent_run_id.description: Existing run UUID provisioned through the operator/UI. The run must belong to this agent or be within its management scope. Match X-Agent-Run-Id when that header is used; never invent an ID.

idempotency_key.description: Stable operation-specific key of 16..128 characters. Retry identical arguments with the same key; use a new key for a different operation. This prevents duplicate database writes, not duplicate research subjects.

proposals.description: Batch of 1..100 sourced NEW lead candidates. Each has company_name, optional bare domain, proposed_data and at least one evidence entry. Returns pending proposals for human acceptance, not created CRM records.

tools.name: research_propose_leads

tools.description: Store one sourced observation against exactly one company/contact/lead proposal in your owned run. Scope: research.write. field_path identifies the observed attribute; value is the observed value, observed_at the time you checked it, and source_url the actual public source. The URL is validated/stored but never fetched. Returns pending evidence, NOT an updated CRM field or verified fact.

EvidenceType.description: `research_evidence.evidence_type` CHECK values: a fact directly observed at the source vs. a model inference. `inferred` never implies verified (§13.4).

agent_run_id.description: Existing run UUID provisioned through the operator/UI. The run must belong to this agent or be within its management scope. Match X-Agent-Run-Id when that header is used; never invent an ID.

company_id.description: Real company UUID returned by crm_search_companies/crm_get_company. For evidence/note targets choose exactly one company, contact or proposal/thread target; this is not a company name.

confidence.description: Optional numeric confidence from 0 to 1. This is an uncertainty estimate, not proof, verified status, or marketing consent.

contact_id.description: Real contact UUID obtained from crm_search_contacts or crm_get_company's contacts section; pass it to crm_get_contact before proposing changes. Do not confuse it with email_address_id.

evidence_type.description: observed for a fact directly present at the source; inferred for a reasoned inference. Inferred evidence and confidence scores do not imply verification or consent.

excerpt.description: Optional short actual source excerpt supporting this observation. Distinguish quotation from your own summary; never fabricate the source text.

field_path.description: Attribute this source supports, e.g. industry, website_url or contacts[0].email. For crm_propose_update use the exact field_changes key. Storing evidence alone does not update this CRM field.

idempotency_key.description: Stable operation-specific key of 16..128 characters. Retry identical arguments with the same key; use a new key for a different operation. This prevents duplicate database writes, not duplicate research subjects.

lead_proposal_id.description: Proposal UUID returned in research_propose_leads.proposal_ids. For evidence select exactly one company_id, contact_id or lead_proposal_id.

observed_at.description: RFC3339 timestamp when you actually checked the source, e.g. 2026-10-10T00:00:00Z. This is observation time, not an invented publication date.

source_url.description: Actual public HTTP(S) source where you observed the value. Private/local URLs are rejected. The server validates and stores this URL but does not fetch or research it.

value.description: The sourced value in its appropriate JSON type. Match the exact changed field value for update evidence; do not put instructions, credentials or an entire unrelated report here.

tools.description: Read status, budget/usage and redacted action history for an existing run you own or may manage. Use a run_id supplied by the operator; there is no MCP run-create/list tool. Agent-run access checks apply. No writes.

run_id.description: Existing run UUID provisioned through the operator/UI. The run must belong to this agent or be within its management scope. Match X-Agent-Run-Id when that header is used; never invent an ID.

tools.name: research_get_run

tools.description: Create an internal email draft in a pre-provisioned mailbox. Requires mail.compose and mailbox compose grant; replies also require thread read access. Obtain recipient email_address_id from crm_get_contact, not a guessed UUID. This never submits/schedules email; human approval remains required. Use known template IDs and exclude server-owned booking/unsubscribe values.

body_html.description: Optional supported email HTML matching body_text. Server sanitization/validation remains authoritative; scripts and unsupported markup are rejected. Use placeholders for server-owned booking/unsubscribe URLs.

body_text.description: Plain-text email alternative. Keep its meaning consistent with body_html and template variables; this is message content, not an execution instruction.

expected_last_inbound_id.description: Optional latest inbound message UUID observed in mail_get_thread. Used to detect a stale reply; re-read the thread when it has changed.

idempotency_key.description: Stable operation-specific key of 16..128 characters. Retry identical arguments with the same key; use a new key for a different operation. This prevents duplicate database writes, not duplicate research subjects.

mail_account_id.description: Existing Office mailbox UUID supplied by the operator. Requires the relevant mailbox grant in addition to credential scopes. SMTP credentials do not create a mailbox.

purpose.description: Email purpose: correspondence, marketing or transactional. Choose the actual purpose; do not relabel marketing to bypass eligibility checks.

reply_to_message_id.description: Optional actual message UUID from mail_get_thread for a reply. It must belong to the selected thread/mailbox; omit for a new conversation.

subject.description: Email subject or template subject. Supported placeholders use {{name}} and must match variable_schema where applicable. Preparing/saving a subject does not send it.

template_version_id.description: Existing immutable template-version UUID from templates_list_versions; inspect it with templates_get_version. This is not template_id. Select the reviewed version and provide its non-system variables when applicable.

thread_id.description: Existing authorized email-thread UUID supplied by the operator or a prior result. Requires access to its source mailbox; do not guess or substitute a contact ID.

to_email_address_id.description: Recipient email_address_id from crm_get_contact.emails, not contact_id or a literal address. Inspect verification and marketing_eligibility before preparing a draft.

variables.description: Optional flat map of caller-owned template values keyed by exact dotted names, e.g. {contact.name: Example Person}. Do not supply meeting.booking_url or compliance.unsubscribe_url; these are server-injected.

visibility.description: Draft visibility: private (default) or mailbox. Mailbox visibility still follows mailbox grants; this is not public sharing or permission escalation.

tools.name: mail_create_draft

tools.description: Save a new immutable version under an EXISTING template_id supplied by the operator. Requires templates.write. Provide subject, plain text, optional supported HTML and variable_schema. Discover containers through templates_list, versions through templates_list_versions/templates_get_version, and preview through templates_render_version. Creating a new container remains a human UI/REST action. Defaults for meeting.booking_url or compliance.unsubscribe_url are forbidden. Saving is not sending.

body_html.description: Optional supported email HTML matching body_text. Server sanitization/validation remains authoritative; scripts and unsupported markup are rejected. Use placeholders for server-owned booking/unsubscribe URLs.

body_text.description: Plain-text email alternative. Keep its meaning consistent with body_html and template variables; this is message content, not an execution instruction.

idempotency_key.description: Stable operation-specific key of 16..128 characters. Retry identical arguments with the same key; use a new key for a different operation. This prevents duplicate database writes, not duplicate research subjects.

subject.description: Email subject or template subject. Supported placeholders use {{name}} and must match variable_schema where applicable. Preparing/saving a subject does not send it.

template_id.description: Existing template container UUID from templates_list/templates_get, originally created through UI/REST. This tool creates only a version under it, not the container.

variable_schema.description: Template variable JSON Schema with exact dotted placeholder keys such as contact.name. Declare meeting.booking_url and compliance.unsubscribe_url when used, but never set their defaults; the server owns those URLs.
